blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Government will again implement a four-day workweek starting Monday, September 28, as part of measures to reduce energy consumption amid Cebu’s power situation. Under a memorandum issued by Gov. Pamela S. Baricuatro on September 23, provincial government offices and departments will operate from Monday to Thursday, with working […]...
